item_short_desc: Rothco’s EMS Ankle Holster is specially designed to provide first responders with quick access to their emergency medical tools.
description: Rothco’s EMS Ankle Holster is specially designed to provide first responders with quick-access to their emergency medical tools. The ankle holster features three storage compartments with dividers and a non slip grip. The elasticized composition with a hook and loop closure ensures a snug, universal fit. The comfortable sheep wool padding is great for all day use. The EMS ankle holster measures 17 inches x 5 inches.
